classes.purpose: Static game-data record describing a 'NA region' of a hunting level/map. Each record links to a CMHLevelInfo cell (by level index) and carries a key/id used to build a per-level region lookup table.

methods.purpose: 3-arg CInfoManager accessor: if name==0 returns the cached CInfoManager<CLevelNARegionInfo> singleton, otherwise looks it up by class name via FUN_11679e10; returns a dummy static manager on failure.

Iterates every CLevelNARegionInfo record; reads region+0x14 (level/cell index) and region+0x18 (key); looks the cell up in the CMHLevelInfo manager (paged id map) and inserts the region pointer into a red-black tree keyed by region+0x18 at cell+0xC0, i.e. builds a per-level region lookup.

fields.note: index used to fetch the owning CMHLevelInfo cell

fields.name: regionKey
fields.note: key inserted into the per-level region tree

Walks the info list backward; for records whose type(+0x1c)==99 and whose range (+0x10..+0x14) is non-empty, builds a temporary sorted/paged vector (cap 6 at param+0x10) of unlock-page entries via FUN_1161xxxx helpers.

classes.purpose: Static data for hunter 'ability cards' — each card grants a list of passive skills. Consumer walks a player's card tree and applies each card's skill list.

methods.purpose: Lazy-init CInfoManager<CHunterAbilityCardInfo> singleton accessor.

Walks a red-black tree (this+0x184/+0x18c) of owned card ids; for nodes where FUN_117f6a10(id)==2, resolves the card in the paged id-map, reads its skill-id vector (card+0x8c..+0x90) and grants each skill via obj(param+0x1b4)->vtbl+0x44 with (0,skillId,0,1,0x13).
Iterates the whole card table and calls FUN_118ad510 for each non-null card.

classes.notes: ApplyCardSkills clearly grants a per-card skill list; type-arg 0x13 to the skill-add call. Offsets 0x8c/0x90 confirmed by the memcpy of the skill-id vector.

classes.purpose: Static data for 'starlight stone' gems socketed into star-stone slots. Records are keyed by an id and a level; consumers pick the correct stone tier for a value and remove/refund socketed stone items.

methods.purpose: Lazy-init CInfoManager<CStarLightStoneInfo> singleton accessor.

Iterates star-stone slots (this+0x4c, stride 0xc, count via CStarStoneSlotInfo); for occupied slots resolves the stone (paged id-map, index shifted by +1), and if its param matches, removes/refunds one stone item via obj+0x44 with (0,itemId,0,1,0x21) and decrements the slot count.
For stone ids 1..4, resolves the record and binary-searches its per-level tree (entry+0x14/+0x18) for key param_1; on match sets *param_2 to the tier index and returns FUN_115a3230(&param_1).

formulas: slot index -> stone id uses (index+1) in FindStoneTierByValue / RefundSlotStones
classes.notes: Related to CStarStoneSlotInfo. Tier count 4 and item-op type 0x21 are load-bearing constants.
